0022600017.text: The Nets (0-4, on a four-game losing streak) host the first-place Pistons (4-1, on a one-game win streak) in Brooklyn in the fifth game of Brooklyn's 2026-27 season and an Emirates NBA Cup East Group A matchup. Brooklyn is 0-2 at home and sits fifth in the Atlantic, 3.5 games back, while Detroit is 2-0 at home and leads the Central. Brooklyn will be without Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain), and Detroit without Jalen Duren (hamstring strain) and Isaiah Joe, who is a game-time decision with a hip bruise. The teams have not met yet this season, and Detroit won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 138-100 win in Brooklyn in their last meeting.
